subject: Marketplace listing — claim scrub + support SLA window confirmation
messages:
From: Ana Silva <ana.silva@cloudpartner.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace-listing@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing checklist — claim matrix + support window

Hi Olga,

We are preparing the AWS/Azure/GCP listing preflight and need one last pass on the product claim language and the support SLA window that will be shown on the cloud portals. Attached is the claims matrix we discussed (listing_claims_matrix.xlsx) and a short support window template.

Could you confirm by EOD which of these statements we can canonically display (marketing copy vs. technical claim), and whether Redwood will offer 24x7 support for launch (or a 9x5 business-hours SLA with an escalation path)? The marketplaces require exact copy for the listing pages and a single support contact/phone or email for the listing metadata.

Specific asks:
- Approve/modify the three highlighted claims in the spreadsheet (security, multi-region routing, private deployment options).
- Confirm the visible support hours and escalation inbox for the listing.
- Provide any trademark/usage constraints for 'Redwood Inference' or the product name if there are restrictions.

We'd like to move this to the portal by 2028-05-02 to align with co-sell enablement.

Attachments: listing_claims_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Ana Silva
Partner GTM, CloudPartner Solutions
ana.silva@cloudpartner.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ana Silva <ana.silva@cloudpartner.com>, AWS Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace-listing@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing checklist — claim matrix + support window

Thanks Ana — forwarding to product/marketing and sales for a quick scrub.

Marissa / Karthik — can you take ownership on the three bullets below? We need final marketplace-friendly copy and a support window decision. Key constraints from legal: do not expand claims beyond what we can cite in the product doc or SOC2 summary. If a claim depends on a Tiered feature (Dedicated/Private) call that out clearly as "Dedicated/Private customers only".

Action items (please reply with line-level copy directly into the spreadsheet and confirm timeline):
- Claim approvals / edits: security data isolation, regional routing guarantees, private deployment availability. (Owner: Marissa)
- Support SLA to display on listing metadata: propose 24x5 (Mon-Fri 8am-8pm PT) for public listing with a note that Dedicated customers have 24x7 escalation. Alternatively, if we can commit 24x7 for launch, confirm Ops owner. (Owner: Karthik)
- Trademark usage: we use the standard logotype in the marketplace banner; creative will request two logo sizes from Design if approved.

I attached our current draft listing copy (redwood_listing_drafts_v3.docx) — please mark up and return. Ana, cc'ing you so you see edits inline.

Olga
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ana Silva <ana.silva@cloudpartner.com>, AWS Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace-listing@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing checklist — claim matrix + support window

Olga / Karthik — I reviewed the matrix and made line-level suggestions. Key changes/highlights below (I pasted the edits into redwood_listing_drafts_v3.docx and added comments in the sheet):

- Security claim: changed from "end-to-end encrypted by default" to "data encrypted at-rest and in-transit; customer-managed keys available for Dedicated/Private deployments." Rationale: cannot state E2E for all ingestion paths.
- Multi-region routing: recommend "supports multi-region inference routing with configurable policies (subject to model placement)." Avoids SLA-like guarantee.
- Private deployment: callout should read: "Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) available for enterprise customers; contact sales for network and compliance packaging."

Support window recommendation: we can display 24x5 (Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00 PT) as the public listing. For Dedicated customers we'll add "24x7 escalation" in the product detail panel and point to the customer support plan doc. Ops has confirmed they can staff 24x7 only after contract signoff and scheduled onboarding (not by portal launch).

Escalation contact for listing metadata: support@redwoodinference.com (primary), +1-888-REDWOOD (escalation number placeholder — Ops will confirm final number).

Design/trademark: OK to use the standard logotype; attached is the preferred banner spec (I added comments).

Attachments referenced: redwood_listing_drafts_v3.docx (with tracked changes), launch_support_matrix.pdf (OPS staffing notes).

I recommend we surface the three edited bullet lines verbatim in the marketplace listing (copy below):
"Data encrypted at-rest and in-transit; customer-managed keys available for Dedicated/Private deployments."
"Supports multi-region inference routing with configurable policies (subject to model placement)."
"Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) available for enterprise customers; contact sales for details."

If Karthik can confirm the public listing support hours we can lock the portal metadata. Timeline: I can finalize copy by 2028-04-26 EOD.

—Marissa
Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Ana Silva <ana.silva@cloudpartner.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-26T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing checklist — claim matrix + support window

Hi all,

Thanks — the suggested copy looks good and keeps us within the marketplaces' content rules. We can proceed with the 24x5 public listing hours and the Dedicated 24x7 escalation note. Two follow-ups before we submit to the portals:

1) Please upload the final assets (docx + the approved banner images) to the shared drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bz_example_listing_assets
2) Complete the vendor evidence checklist in the HubSpot deal (link below) — the portal team will not accept incomplete evidence: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/RDW-2028-0193

We will queue the listing for review once both are in place. I will also open the DocuSign for the co-sell acknowledgement (we generally require a brief co-sell MSA addendum for marketplace featured listings). Expect DocuSign to come from aws-marketplace-notify@amazon.com.

If Ops confirms the final escalation phone number by EOD tomorrow we can hit the 2028-05-02 publish target. Attached: marketplace-side checklist (for reference).

Cheers,
